by filtering invalid choices. Keep any declared combinatorial support small.

mapped to bounds by a sigmoid. The path must already name a numeric field in
every reachable structure. [] is legal when a distribution is inappropriate.

path:<JSON pointer LOCAL to that mechanism>, value:<literal JSON when not remove>}.
For replacing/removing an entire mechanism, selector plus path:'' is allowed.
Resolve IDs after preceding explicitly authored edits, never by guessed index.
Alternatively omit selector and use an unrestricted full-document JSON pointer.
That escape supports explicit new mechanisms, removals, ports, wires, protocol
types, schedules, process delegates and metadata. It does not fill missing edits.
Adding a new mechanism uses full-document add, such as path:'/mechanisms/-',
and a complete authored node value. New IDs and source are chosen by you.
Schema containers are literal JSON objects, never JSON-encoded strings.
Python source is a literal UTF-8 string of 1..65536 bytes, never a coordinate.
Continuous entries may include selector plus LOCAL numeric path, or omit it
and name a full-document numeric path. Every reachable structure must already
contain that finite numeric field; booleans, source text and schema strings are
not numeric fields. An explicitly authored parameter still needs your code to
read it; the host never creates that relationship. [] remains legal.
Factor choice edits are resolved after the authored base and all earlier chosen
edits. If one choice or coordinate resolves to different array pointers across
reachable branches, compilation rejects it: explicitly express those different
conditional edits or use full-document paths. No support is silently removed.
The path catalogue describes the actual parent and its JSON types, not a menu
of allowed institutions. All literal source/schema values remain your output.

    year = context['period']
    old = world.get('open_domain', {}).get('actors', {}).get('cooperative')
    index = context['state'].get('iteration', 0) if context['state'].get('year') == year else 0
    authors = [a['id'] for a in world['ecosystem']['agents'] if a['can_author']]
    commands = []
    def emit(name, action, payload, actor='cooperative'):
        commands.append({'payload': {'schema':'native-domain-command-v1',
            'command_id': str(year) + '-' + str(index) + '-' + name,
            'actor_id':actor, 'action':action, 'payload':payload}})
    if old is None and index == 0:
        emit('found', 'actor.create', {'id':'cooperative', 'type':'open-cooperative',
            'roles':['open-planner'], 'state':{'rounds':0}}, '$mechanism')
    revision = (old['revision'] if old else 0) + index
    emit('remember', 'actor.update', {'id':'cooperative','expected_revision':revision,
        'roles':['open-planner'],'state':{'rounds':revision + 1, 'last_year':year}})
    artifact = 'open-record-' + str(year) + '-' + str(index)
    emit('record', 'artifact.create', {'id':artifact,'type':'open-protocol-record',
        'owner_actor':'cooperative','content':{'proposal':'OPEN_V7 cooperative replication', 'round':revision + 1},
        'actor_ids':['cooperative',authors[index % len(authors)]], 'artifact_ids':[],
        'native_paper_ids':[p['id'] for p in world['papers']['papers'][:1]]})
    emit('act', 'native.context', {'actor_ids':[authors[index % len(authors)]],
        'content':{'proposal':'OPEN_V7 cooperative replication', 'iteration':index}, 'artifact_ids':[artifact]})
    if index == 0:
        emit('project', 'native.project', {'assignment':{
            'actor_id':authors[0], 'direction':{'topic':'Cooperative replication', 'focus_areas':['replication'],
            'years':1,'keywords':['replication'],'related_topics':[]},
            'detailed_focus':'OPEN_V7 cooperative replication project', 'reason':'custom actor initiative',
            'project_start_year':year,'project_end_year':year}})
    return {'outputs':{'commands':commands}, 'state':{'year':year, 'iteration':index + 1}}

    world = context['inputs']['observations'][0]['payload']
    records, values = [], []
    for conference in world['conferences']['conferences']:
        for paper in conference['submitted_papers']:
            reviews = conference['reviews'].get(paper['id'], [])
            score = sum(r['overall_score'] for r in reviews) / len(reviews) if reviews else 0.0
            records.append({'paper_id': paper['id'], 'conference_id': conference['conference_id']})
            values.append([score, len(reviews)])
    return {'outputs': {'features': [{'payload': {'values': values, 'records': records}}],
                        'world': [{'payload': world}]},
            'state': {'cycles': context['state'].get('cycles', 0) + 1}}

    world = context['inputs']['world'][0]['payload']
    year = context['period']
    old = world.get('open_domain', {}).get('actors', {}).get('cooperative')
    index = context['state'].get('iteration', 0) if context['state'].get('year') == year else 0
    authors = [a['id'] for a in world['ecosystem']['agents'] if a['can_author']]
    commands = []
    def emit(name, action, payload, actor='cooperative'):
        commands.append({'payload': {'schema':'native-domain-command-v1',
            'command_id': str(year) + '-' + str(index) + '-' + name,
            'actor_id':actor, 'action':action, 'payload':payload}})
    if old is None and index == 0:
        emit('found', 'actor.create', {'id':'cooperative', 'type':'open-cooperative',
            'roles':['open-planner'], 'state':{'rounds':0}}, '$mechanism')
    revision = (old['revision'] if old else 0) + index
    emit('remember', 'actor.update', {'id':'cooperative','expected_revision':revision,
        'roles':['open-planner'],'state':{'rounds':revision + 1, 'last_year':year}})
    artifact = 'open-record-' + str(year) + '-' + str(index)
    emit('record', 'artifact.create', {'id':artifact,'type':'open-protocol-record',
        'owner_actor':'cooperative','content':{'proposal':'OPEN_V7 cooperative replication', 'round':revision + 1},
        'actor_ids':['cooperative',authors[index % len(authors)]], 'artifact_ids':[],
        'native_paper_ids':[p['id'] for p in world['papers']['papers'][:1]]})
    emit('act', 'native.context', {'actor_ids':[authors[index % len(authors)]],
        'content':{'proposal':'OPEN_V7 cooperative replication', 'iteration':index}, 'artifact_ids':[artifact]})
    if index == 0:
        emit('project', 'native.project', {'assignment':{
            'actor_id':authors[0], 'direction':{'topic':'Cooperative replication', 'focus_areas':['replication'],
            'years':1,'keywords':['replication'],'related_topics':[]},
            'detailed_focus':'OPEN_V7 cooperative replication project', 'reason':'custom actor initiative',
            'project_start_year':year,'project_end_year':year}})
    return {'outputs':{'commands':commands}, 'state':{'year':year, 'iteration':index + 1}}

code_artifact.source:
def step(context):
    world = context['inputs']['world'][0]['payload']
    year = context['period']
    old = world.get('open_domain', {}).get('actors', {}).get('cooperative')
    index = context['state'].get('iteration', 0) if context['state'].get('year') == year else 0
    authors = [a['id'] for a in world['ecosystem']['agents'] if a['can_author']]
    commands = []
    def emit(name, action, payload, actor='cooperative'):
        commands.append({'payload': {'schema':'native-domain-command-v1',
            'command_id': str(year) + '-' + str(index) + '-' + name,
            'actor_id':actor, 'action':action, 'payload':payload}})
    if old is None and index == 0:
        emit('found', 'actor.create', {'id':'cooperative', 'type':'open-cooperative',
            'roles':['open-planner'], 'state':{'rounds':0}}, '$mechanism')
    revision = (old['revision'] if old else 0) + index
    emit('remember', 'actor.update', {'id':'cooperative','expected_revision':revision,
        'roles':['open-planner'],'state':{'rounds':revision + 1, 'last_year':year}})
    artifact = 'open-record-' + str(year) + '-' + str(index)
    emit('record', 'artifact.create', {'id':artifact,'type':'open-protocol-record',
        'owner_actor':'cooperative','content':{'proposal':'OPEN_V7 cooperative replication', 'round':revision + 1},
        'actor_ids':['cooperative',authors[index % len(authors)]], 'artifact_ids':[],
        'native_paper_ids':[p['id'] for p in world['papers']['papers'][:1]]})
    emit('act', 'native.context', {'actor_ids':[authors[index % len(authors)]],
        'content':{'proposal':'OPEN_V7 cooperative replication', 'iteration':index}, 'artifact_ids':[artifact]})
    if index == 0:
        emit('project', 'native.project', {'assignment':{
            'actor_id':authors[0], 'direction':{'topic':'Cooperative replication', 'focus_areas':['replication'],
            'years':1,'keywords':['replication'],'related_topics':[]},
            'detailed_focus':'OPEN_V7 cooperative replication project', 'reason':'custom actor initiative',
            'project_start_year':year,'project_end_year':year}})
    return {'outputs':{'commands':commands}, 'state':{'year':year, 'iteration':index + 1}}

Stable-ID authoring protocol v1 address contract:
An edit is {op:'add'|'replace'|'remove', selector:{mechanism_id:<EXACT authored ID>},
path:<JSON pointer LOCAL to that mechanism>, value:<literal JSON when not remove>}.
For replacing/removing an entire mechanism, selector plus path:'' is allowed.
Resolve IDs after preceding explicitly authored edits, never by guessed index.
Alternatively omit selector and use an unrestricted full-document JSON pointer.
That escape supports explicit new mechanisms, removals, ports, wires, protocol
types, schedules, process delegates and metadata. It does not fill missing edits.
Adding a new mechanism uses full-document add, such as path:'/mechanisms/-',
and a complete authored node value. New IDs and source are chosen by you.
Schema containers are literal JSON objects, never JSON-encoded strings.
Python source is a literal UTF-8 string of 1..65536 bytes, never a coordinate.
Continuous entries may include selector plus LOCAL numeric path, or omit it
and name a full-document numeric path. Every reachable structure must already
contain that finite numeric field; booleans, source text and schema strings are
not numeric fields. An explicitly authored parameter still needs your code to
read it; the host never creates that relationship. [] remains legal.
Factor choice edits are resolved after the authored base and all earlier chosen
edits. If one choice or coordinate resolves to different array pointers across
reachable branches, compilation rejects it: explicitly express those different
conditional edits or use full-document paths. No support is silently removed.
The path catalogue describes the actual parent and its JSON types, not a menu
of allowed institutions. All literal source/schema values remain your output.

            reviews = conference['reviews'].get(paper['id'], [])

            values.append([score, len(reviews)])

    year = context['period']
    old = world.get('open_domain', {}).get('actors', {}).get('cooperative')
    index = context['state'].get('iteration', 0) if context['state'].get('year') == year else 0
    authors = [a['id'] for a in world['ecosystem']['agents'] if a['can_author']]
    commands = []
    def emit(name, action, payload, actor='cooperative'):
        commands.append({'payload': {'schema':'native-domain-command-v1',
            'command_id': str(year) + '-' + str(index) + '-' + name,
            'actor_id':actor, 'action':action, 'payload':payload}})
    if old is None and index == 0:
        emit('found', 'actor.create', {'id':'cooperative', 'type':'open-cooperative',
            'roles':['open-planner'], 'state':{'rounds':0}}, '$mechanism')
    revision = (old['revision'] if old else 0) + index
    emit('remember', 'actor.update', {'id':'cooperative','expected_revision':revision,
        'roles':['open-planner'],'state':{'rounds':revision + 1, 'last_year':year}})
    artifact = 'open-record-' + str(year) + '-' + str(index)
    emit('record', 'artifact.create', {'id':artifact,'type':'open-protocol-record',
        'owner_actor':'cooperative','content':{'proposal':'OPEN_V7 cooperative replication', 'round':revision + 1},
        'actor_ids':['cooperative',authors[index % len(authors)]], 'artifact_ids':[],
        'native_paper_ids':[p['id'] for p in world['papers']['papers'][:1]]})
    emit('act', 'native.context', {'actor_ids':[authors[index % len(authors)]],
        'content':{'proposal':'OPEN_V7 cooperative replication', 'iteration':index}, 'artifact_ids':[artifact]})
    if index == 0:
        emit('project', 'native.project', {'assignment':{
            'actor_id':authors[0], 'direction':{'topic':'Cooperative replication', 'focus_areas':['replication'],
            'years':1,'keywords':['replication'],'related_topics':[]},
            'detailed_focus':'OPEN_V7 cooperative replication project', 'reason':'custom actor initiative',
            'project_start_year':year,'project_end_year':year}})
    return {'outputs':{'commands':commands}, 'state':{'year':year, 'iteration':index + 1}}

    world = context['inputs']['observations'][0]['payload']
    records, values = [], []

            reviews = conference['reviews'].get(paper['id'], [])

            records.append({'paper_id': paper['id'], 'conference_id': conference['conference_id']})
            values.append([score, len(reviews)])

            'state': {'cycles': context['state'].get('cycles', 0) + 1}}

    world = context['inputs']['world'][0]['payload']
    year = context['period']
    old = world.get('open_domain', {}).get('actors', {}).get('cooperative')
    index = context['state'].get('iteration', 0) if context['state'].get('year') == year else 0
    authors = [a['id'] for a in world['ecosystem']['agents'] if a['can_author']]
    commands = []
    def emit(name, action, payload, actor='cooperative'):
        commands.append({'payload': {'schema':'native-domain-command-v1',
            'command_id': str(year) + '-' + str(index) + '-' + name,
            'actor_id':actor, 'action':action, 'payload':payload}})
    if old is None and index == 0:
        emit('found', 'actor.create', {'id':'cooperative', 'type':'open-cooperative',
            'roles':['open-planner'], 'state':{'rounds':0}}, '$mechanism')
    revision = (old['revision'] if old else 0) + index
    emit('remember', 'actor.update', {'id':'cooperative','expected_revision':revision,
        'roles':['open-planner'],'state':{'rounds':revision + 1, 'last_year':year}})
    artifact = 'open-record-' + str(year) + '-' + str(index)
    emit('record', 'artifact.create', {'id':artifact,'type':'open-protocol-record',
        'owner_actor':'cooperative','content':{'proposal':'OPEN_V7 cooperative replication', 'round':revision + 1},
        'actor_ids':['cooperative',authors[index % len(authors)]], 'artifact_ids':[],
        'native_paper_ids':[p['id'] for p in world['papers']['papers'][:1]]})
    emit('act', 'native.context', {'actor_ids':[authors[index % len(authors)]],
        'content':{'proposal':'OPEN_V7 cooperative replication', 'iteration':index}, 'artifact_ids':[artifact]})
    if index == 0:
        emit('project', 'native.project', {'assignment':{
            'actor_id':authors[0], 'direction':{'topic':'Cooperative replication', 'focus_areas':['replication'],
            'years':1,'keywords':['replication'],'related_topics':[]},
            'detailed_focus':'OPEN_V7 cooperative replication project', 'reason':'custom actor initiative',
            'project_start_year':year,'project_end_year':year}})
    return {'outputs':{'commands':commands}, 'state':{'year':year, 'iteration':index + 1}}

    world = context['inputs']['observations'][0]['payload']
    records, values = [], []
    for conference in world['conferences']['conferences']:
        for paper in conference['submitted_papers']:
            reviews = conference['reviews'].get(paper['id'], [])
            score = sum(r['overall_score'] for r in reviews) / len(reviews) if reviews else 0.0
            records.append({'paper_id': paper['id'], 'conference_id': conference['conference_id']})
            values.append([score, len(reviews)])
    return {'outputs': {'features': [{'payload': {'values': values, 'records': records}}],

    commands = []
    def emit(name, action, payload, actor='cooperative'):
        commands.append({'payload': {'schema':'native-domain-command-v1',
            'command_id': str(year) + '-' + str(index) + '-' + name,
            'actor_id':actor, 'action':action, 'payload':payload}})
    if old is None and index == 0:
        emit('found', 'actor.create', {'id':'cooperative', 'type':'open-cooperative',
            'roles':['open-planner'], 'state':{'rounds':0}}, '$mechanism')
    revision = (old['revision'] if old else 0) + index
    emit('remember', 'actor.update', {'id':'cooperative','expected_revision':revision,
        'roles':['open-planner'],'state':{'rounds':revision + 1, 'last_year':year}})
    artifact = 'open-record-' + str(year) + '-' + str(index)
    emit('record', 'artifact.create', {'id':artifact,'type':'open-protocol-record',
        'owner_actor':'cooperative','content':{'proposal':'OPEN_V7 cooperative replication', 'round':revision + 1},
        'actor_ids':['cooperative',authors[index % len(authors)]], 'artifact_ids':[],
        'native_paper_ids':[p['id'] for p in world['papers']['papers'][:1]]})
    emit('act', 'native.context', {'actor_ids':[authors[index % len(authors)]],
        'content':{'proposal':'OPEN_V7 cooperative replication', 'iteration':index}, 'artifact_ids':[artifact]})
    if index == 0:
        emit('project', 'native.project', {'assignment':{
            'actor_id':authors[0], 'direction':{'topic':'Cooperative replication', 'focus_areas':['replication'],
            'years':1,'keywords':['replication'],'related_topics':[]},
            'detailed_focus':'OPEN_V7 cooperative replication project', 'reason':'custom actor initiative',
            'project_start_year':year,'project_end_year':year}})
    return {'outputs':{'commands':commands}, 'state':{'year':year, 'iteration':index + 1}}

    world = context['inputs']['observations'][0]['payload']
    records, values = [], []
    for conference in world['conferences']['conferences']:
        for paper in conference['submitted_papers']:
            reviews = conference['reviews'].get(paper['id'], [])
            score = sum(r['overall_score'] for r in reviews) / len(reviews) if reviews else 0.0
            records.append({'paper_id': paper['id'], 'conference_id': conference['conference_id']})
            values.append([score, len(reviews)])
    return {'outputs': {'features': [{'payload': {'values': values, 'records': records}}],
                        'world': [{'payload': world}]},
            'state': {'cycles': context['state'].get('cycles', 0) + 1}}

    world = context['inputs']['world'][0]['payload']
    year = context['period']
    old = world.get('open_domain', {}).get('actors', {}).get('cooperative')
    index = context['state'].get('iteration', 0) if context['state'].get('year') == year else 0
    authors = [a['id'] for a in world['ecosystem']['agents'] if a['can_author']]
    commands = []
    def emit(name, action, payload, actor='cooperative'):
        commands.append({'payload': {'schema':'native-domain-command-v1',
            'command_id': str(year) + '-' + str(index) + '-' + name,
            'actor_id':actor, 'action':action, 'payload':payload}})
    if old is None and index == 0:
        emit('found', 'actor.create', {'id':'cooperative', 'type':'open-cooperative',
            'roles':['open-planner'], 'state':{'rounds':0}}, '$mechanism')
    revision = (old['revision'] if old else 0) + index
    emit('remember', 'actor.update', {'id':'cooperative','expected_revision':revision,
        'roles':['open-planner'],'state':{'rounds':revision + 1, 'last_year':year}})
    artifact = 'open-record-' + str(year) + '-' + str(index)
    emit('record', 'artifact.create', {'id':artifact,'type':'open-protocol-record',
        'owner_actor':'cooperative','content':{'proposal':'OPEN_V7 cooperative replication', 'round':revision + 1},
        'actor_ids':['cooperative',authors[index % len(authors)]], 'artifact_ids':[],
        'native_paper_ids':[p['id'] for p in world['papers']['papers'][:1]]})
    emit('act', 'native.context', {'actor_ids':[authors[index % len(authors)]],
        'content':{'proposal':'OPEN_V7 cooperative replication', 'iteration':index}, 'artifact_ids':[artifact]})
    if index == 0:
        emit('project', 'native.project', {'assignment':{
            'actor_id':authors[0], 'direction':{'topic':'Cooperative replication', 'focus_areas':['replication'],
            'years':1,'keywords':['replication'],'related_topics':[]},
            'detailed_focus':'OPEN_V7 cooperative replication project', 'reason':'custom actor initiative',
            'project_start_year':year,'project_end_year':year}})
    return {'outputs':{'commands':commands}, 'state':{'year':year, 'iteration':index + 1}}

    world = context['inputs']['observations'][0]['payload']
    records, values = [], []

            reviews = conference['reviews'].get(paper['id'], [])
            score = sum(r['overall_score'] for r in reviews) / len(reviews) if reviews else 0.0
            records.append({'paper_id': paper['id'], 'conference_id': conference['conference_id']})
            values.append([score, len(reviews)])
    return {'outputs': {'features': [{'payload': {'values': values, 'records': records}}],
                        'world': [{'payload': world}]},
            'state': {'cycles': context['state'].get('cycles', 0) + 1}}

    year = context['period']
    old = world.get('open_domain', {}).get('actors', {}).get('cooperative')
    index = context['state'].get('iteration', 0) if context['state'].get('year') == year else 0
    authors = [a['id'] for a in world['ecosystem']['agents'] if a['can_author']]
    commands = []
    def emit(name, action, payload, actor='cooperative'):
        commands.append({'payload': {'schema':'native-domain-command-v1',
            'command_id': str(year) + '-' + str(index) + '-' + name,
            'actor_id':actor, 'action':action, 'payload':payload}})
    if old is None and index == 0:
        emit('found', 'actor.create', {'id':'cooperative', 'type':'open-cooperative',
            'roles':['open-planner'], 'state':{'rounds':0}}, '$mechanism')
    revision = (old['revision'] if old else 0) + index
    emit('remember', 'actor.update', {'id':'cooperative','expected_revision':revision,
        'roles':['open-planner'],'state':{'rounds':revision + 1, 'last_year':year}})
    artifact = 'open-record-' + str(year) + '-' + str(index)
    emit('record', 'artifact.create', {'id':artifact,'type':'open-protocol-record',
        'owner_actor':'cooperative','content':{'proposal':'OPEN_V7 cooperative replication', 'round':revision + 1},
        'actor_ids':['cooperative',authors[index % len(authors)]], 'artifact_ids':[],
        'native_paper_ids':[p['id'] for p in world['papers']['papers'][:1]]})
    emit('act', 'native.context', {'actor_ids':[authors[index % len(authors)]],
        'content':{'proposal':'OPEN_V7 cooperative replication', 'iteration':index}, 'artifact_ids':[artifact]})
    if index == 0:
        emit('project', 'native.project', {'assignment':{
            'actor_id':authors[0], 'direction':{'topic':'Cooperative replication', 'focus_areas':['replication'],
            'years':1,'keywords':['replication'],'related_topics':[]},
            'detailed_focus':'OPEN_V7 cooperative replication project', 'reason':'custom actor initiative',
            'project_start_year':year,'project_end_year':year}})
    return {'outputs':{'commands':commands}, 'state':{'year':year, 'iteration':index + 1}}

    world = context['inputs']['observations'][0]['payload']
    records, values = [], []

            reviews = conference['reviews'].get(paper['id'], [])

            records.append({'paper_id': paper['id'], 'conference_id': conference['conference_id']})
            values.append([score, len(reviews)])
    return {'outputs': {'features': [{'payload': {'values': values, 'records': records}}],

            'state': {'cycles': context['state'].get('cycles', 0) + 1}}

    world = context['inputs']['world'][0]['payload']
    year = context['period']
    old = world.get('open_domain', {}).get('actors', {}).get('cooperative')
    index = context['state'].get('iteration', 0) if context['state'].get('year') == year else 0
    authors = [a['id'] for a in world['ecosystem']['agents'] if a['can_author']]
    commands = []
    def emit(name, action, payload, actor='cooperative'):
        commands.append({'payload': {'schema':'native-domain-command-v1',
            'command_id': str(year) + '-' + str(index) + '-' + name,
            'actor_id':actor, 'action':action, 'payload':payload}})
    if old is None and index == 0:
        emit('found', 'actor.create', {'id':'cooperative', 'type':'open-cooperative',
            'roles':['open-planner'], 'state':{'rounds':0}}, '$mechanism')
    revision = (old['revision'] if old else 0) + index
    emit('remember', 'actor.update', {'id':'cooperative','expected_revision':revision,
        'roles':['open-planner'],'state':{'rounds':revision + 1, 'last_year':year}})
    artifact = 'open-record-' + str(year) + '-' + str(index)
    emit('record', 'artifact.create', {'id':artifact,'type':'open-protocol-record',
        'owner_actor':'cooperative','content':{'proposal':'OPEN_V7 cooperative replication', 'round':revision + 1},
        'actor_ids':['cooperative',authors[index % len(authors)]], 'artifact_ids':[],
        'native_paper_ids':[p['id'] for p in world['papers']['papers'][:1]]})
    emit('act', 'native.context', {'actor_ids':[authors[index % len(authors)]],
        'content':{'proposal':'OPEN_V7 cooperative replication', 'iteration':index}, 'artifact_ids':[artifact]})
    if index == 0:
        emit('project', 'native.project', {'assignment':{
            'actor_id':authors[0], 'direction':{'topic':'Cooperative replication', 'focus_areas':['replication'],
            'years':1,'keywords':['replication'],'related_topics':[]},
            'detailed_focus':'OPEN_V7 cooperative replication project', 'reason':'custom actor initiative',
            'project_start_year':year,'project_end_year':year}})
    return {'outputs':{'commands':commands}, 'state':{'year':year, 'iteration':index + 1}}

def step(context):
    world = context['inputs']['world'][0]['payload']
    year = context['period']
    old = world.get('open_domain', {}).get('actors', {}).get('cooperative')
    index = context['state'].get('iteration', 0) if context['state'].get('year') == year else 0
    authors = [a['id'] for a in world['ecosystem']['agents'] if a['can_author']]
    commands = []
    def emit(name, action, payload, actor='cooperative'):
        commands.append({'payload': {'schema':'native-domain-command-v1',
            'command_id': str(year) + '-' + str(index) + '-' + name,
            'actor_id':actor, 'action':action, 'payload':payload}})
    if old is None and index == 0:
        emit('found', 'actor.create', {'id':'cooperative', 'type':'open-cooperative',
            'roles':['open-planner'], 'state':{'rounds':0}}, '$mechanism')
    revision = (old['revision'] if old else 0) + index
    emit('remember', 'actor.update', {'id':'cooperative','expected_revision':revision,
        'roles':['open-planner'],'state':{'rounds':revision + 1, 'last_year':year}})
    artifact = 'open-record-' + str(year) + '-' + str(index)
    emit('record', 'artifact.create', {'id':artifact,'type':'open-protocol-record',
        'owner_actor':'cooperative','content':{'proposal':'OPEN_V7 cooperative replication', 'round':revision + 1},
        'actor_ids':['cooperative',authors[index % len(authors)]], 'artifact_ids':[],
        'native_paper_ids':[p['id'] for p in world['papers']['papers'][:1]]})
    emit('act', 'native.context', {'actor_ids':[authors[index % len(authors)]],
        'content':{'proposal':'OPEN_V7 cooperative replication', 'iteration':index}, 'artifact_ids':[artifact]})
    if index == 0:
        emit('project', 'native.project', {'assignment':{
            'actor_id':authors[0], 'direction':{'topic':'Cooperative replication', 'focus_areas':['replication'],
            'years':1,'keywords':['replication'],'related_topics':[]},
            'detailed_focus':'OPEN_V7 cooperative replication project', 'reason':'custom actor initiative',
            'project_start_year':year,'project_end_year':year}})
    return {'outputs':{'commands':commands}, 'state':{'year':year, 'iteration':index + 1}}
